judge_info.rule: One fixed judge pair for every run. Judges mark only the explanation of tutor items, and the explanation passes only when both judges pass it. When the candidate is in the family of either judge, or a judge is missing from the live model list, the explanation is not scored.

gold.note: Gold comes from the source files named on each item. Teanga Bench did not have native-speaker review. An item counts as human-checked only when its source file records human review. Judge marks on tutor explanations are made by models and are not human-validated.

truncation.rule: A scored item-epoch is truncated when a candidate call stopped at the answer limit. It is scored by the normal rules, so an empty answer scores 0.
